changelog: 差异化迭代 v2.2.0：保留有意文学装置（复调意象/象征/方言）、场景模式（论文/简历/小红书/小说/公文）、中文特有问题（引号/破折号/黑话/机械分层）
summary: Remove AI writing patterns from text with taste - not by blindly stripping every em dash. Use when editing or reviewing articles, novels, resumes, or social posts. Preserves deliberate literary devices the author meant to keep (polyphonic imagery, intentional symbolism, dialect), and adapts rules per genre (academic / resume / social / fiction / official). Detects 24 patterns: inflated symbolism, promotional language, em-dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary, negative parallelisms, and more.
